Happy Birthday to my day one.

If I could give you anything in this world, I would. But since I can’t always give you things physically, I wanted to give you the pieces of us — our memories, flowers, and words that remind you of how much you mean to me.

Last year, I gave you LEGO flowers that reminded me of how you helped build me up. This year, I want to give you something that holds the memories we’ve built together. Even though we don’t often see each other or go out as we’d like, I’m grateful that our friendship remains the same and special to me. I hope you know that I’ll always be here for you. I’ll always support you, celebrate your happiness, and be with you through the difficult days. I’d do and give you everything, and I will always be wishing the best for you.

Thank you for being my day one and for being with me through so many chapters of my life. If I could give you the world, I would, but for now, I hope this reminds you that you’ll always have a special place in me.

I love you endlessly.
Happy birthday, my day one!
